summary: GFL Environmental Inc. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 29, 2026, announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.0169 per outstanding subordinate voting share and multiple voting share for the third quarter of 2026. The dividend is payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on October 14, 2026, and is designated an eligible dividend under Canada's Income Tax Act. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist, review, or structural event is present; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation.
